messages:
ela: Quick QA from staging: rotate flow has 3 small UX/accessibility issues.

priya (design): share bullets pls.

ela: 1) copy toast covers the key drawer on narrow screens. 2) screen readers not announcing copy success/failure. 3) empty API keys page shows a big policy banner + CTA (feels redundant).

jon (frontend): For (1) we can move global toast to top-right and add an inline ephemeral confirmation next to the key.

ada (a11y): Need aria-live region for copy events and focus management when drawer opens. Use role="dialog" and focus the primary CTA. For failures use assertive announcement.

sam (security): Reminder: plaintext is one-time only. Any UI must remove secret from DOM after action and not persist in logs. If we add inline helpers, ensure they never contain full token.

priya (design): Proposal: drawer shows key + Copy / Download CTAs. After action replace plaintext with masked summary and show small banner: "This key will not be shown again. Store it securely." Keep checkbox optional. Condense empty state: primary CTA + small policy line.

jon (frontend): Ill implement: move global snack, add hidden aria-live element, inline confirmation, DOM cleanup (remove plaintext node after action). Will add unit + e2e for failed clipboard path.

deploy-bot: deploy:staging started for branch ux/keys-fixes by @jon at 2024-07-12T09:22:00Z

ela: Thanks, ping when staging is up and Ill validate. :white_check_mark:
